releaseNotes: v1.7.2: DHM now reads the Health Status (and Echo Online Status) that many drivers publish. When a driver reports offline, the device shows Poor at best with a note, Z-Wave and Zigbee devices are checked with the hub radio right away, and real activity always wins over the driver. Also adds Force scan to the main page, a Battery Monitor 2.0 card in Help & Support, a grayed Verified pill while a battery is dead, and a short explainer on the Locations page. v1.7.1: a Zigbee, Z-Wave or Matter device reporting a battery of 5% or lower shows Poor at best, and the Locations Move pickers no longer show stale picks.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Device Health Monitor
apps.description: Learns each device's normal check-in pattern and flags devices that go quiet, with verification, locations, snooze, and a live web portal.
